summary.content:
Today's selection covers 34 articles from 7 trusted sources, including 22 on Artificial Intelligence and 5 on Fraud/Cybersecurity.

• **AI Spotlight**: In San Francisco’s A.I. Era, Even $180,000 Tech Salaries Are No Longer Enough
• **Companies in Focus**: Coverage includes developments from OpenAI, Google, Anthropic
• **Security Alert**: How Meta’s Threads Became as Popular as X
• **Threat Landscape**: Today's coverage highlights phishing, data breaches
• **Source Diversity**: Articles sourced from NY Times Tech, The Verge, BleepingComputer, TechCrunch, BBC Technology and others
• **Fresh Content**: 5 articles published in the last 24 hours
